name: Know Your Clown
tagline: A hopeful degen enters the Ministry of Airdrops for a life-changing allocation. Mechanical cameras take his face, a bureaucrat interrogates his dog, and the verification escalates into a CAPTCHA ballet, an ancestral audit and a soul appraisal. Procedures keep coming beyond three minutes. Cash out to abandon the claim in a tinfoil poncho before the machine ships his identity and dispenses one peanut.
